remainingGaps: Nested document tabs and tab duplication; Google tab nesting up to3 levels is not implemented.

Formatting suggestions, comments attached to suggestions, preview accepted/rejected state and Office tracked-change metadata interchange are not implemented. Formatting applies directly; exported pending suggestions are visible text without review metadata.

Onscreen pagination inserts gaps between top-level blocks; oversized single paragraphs/tables are not split with line-level fidelity, and footnotes appear at end of tab rather than each page. Native print pagination handles internal lines independently.
Citation manager/bibliography, rendered equation editor, editable smart/dropdown chips, drawings, bookmarks/cross-references, multicolumn section layouts and line numbers are not implemented.
DOCX supports a bounded local OOXML vocabulary; complex sections, advanced tables, unsupported objects, linked media, endnotes and review metadata may be simplified or omitted with import warnings.
Markdown implements tested portable constructs; page layout, fonts, image wrapping and review metadata are not portable. Raw HTML is escaped.
Voice typing, translation, AI writing, add-ons and account-backed integrations remain outside the local credential-free implementation.
Independent browser validation is required for native text input, selection, resizing, printing, pagination and saves. Semantic tests alone are not acceptance.
benchmarkHarnessLimit: Comparable XML tests apply the same Happy DOM21 wildcard-namespace compatibility lookup to both target subjects; sources remain unchanged. UI/native file chooser remains separately blocked/unverified. Exported OOXML is inspected directly and import fixture is manually authored, not only self-roundtripped.
